title: 第21章 区区外门弟子岂有能耐修炼这部武学第22章 传功台上一拳打爆
lines: 功体太弱发不出力，所以下限低。
肉身强大，可完成连续的爆发，达到超越上限的战斗力。
修长老一边眯着眼，一边搓了搓鼻子下的胡须，随即说道：“所以那些不够硬的小老弟，你们可以先走了，这部武学注定跟你们无缘，不用不好意思……”
原本都还在认真听讲的众人顿时满脸的黑线。
“我想冲上去刀了这老头。”
“我去年就想这么干了，奈何打不过啊！”
“妈的，总有他老得动不了的时候，到时候我给他老骨头都拆了。”
“算我一个。”
“还有我。”
看着场下的众人的反响，修长老悄咪眯的把眼睛睁开一条缝。
“看来大家是对这部下品武学很感兴趣啊？你们都很勇吗？”
“唉，我说修老，您能别再拖时间了吗？”
一名年轻弟子忍不住的说道：“今天是本月第一天，一会我们还得去领取修炼的资源呢！”
“对啊！
修长老，你赶紧接着讲吧！
我觉得自己很强，可以试试这部《九连崩击》。”
场中的萧诺也是愈发诧异，明明一个个都对修长老怨气颇重，可还是只有少部分人离场。
当然了，和萧诺一样疑惑的不只有他。
旁边不远处有个今年刚入门的新人对身边的人发起询问。
“你们为什么都不走？一部下品武学而已，就算是给我们家族的后辈，都没有几个人愿意修炼的。”
旁边的人回答：“你刚来，有所不知。
修长老传授的功法实用性都非常高，而且还通俗易懂，但这老头唯一的缺点，就是废话太多，经常能把人气个半死。”
“实用性高？”
那名新人更不解了。
“没错，实际上修长老传授出来的功法，都是经过了他调整改良过的，所谓的，下品武学，中品武学，只是他随口念叨出来的，至于他传授的武学实际有多强，只有真正修炼了才知道。”
“原来如此！”
骂归骂，怨归怨，哪怕想刀一个人的眼神藏不住，但对于修长老在传功这方面的认可，却毋庸置疑。
修长老坐在石椅上，自顾自的伸了个懒腰。
“我都已经讲完了……接下来是‘演练实战’环节。”
此言一出，二十四号传功台顿时嘈杂不已。
“这就讲完了？有没有搞错？”
“修长老，别搞事情啊！”
面对众人的极力劝说，修长老不予理会。
“我都说得很清楚了，《九连崩击》是依靠人体的九个强大发力点连续发力，肉身越强，蕴含的内劲就越猛，连击出来的效果就越好……这么简单的道理，还要怎么解释？”
“直接‘演练’吧！”
content_en:
The gong body is too weak to produce force, so the lower limit is low.
The physical body is powerful and can complete continuous bursts, reaching combat power beyond the upper limit.
Elder Xiu squinted his eyes and rubbed the beard under his nose, and then said: "So those who are not tough enough, you can leave first. This martial arts is destined to be missed by you, so don't be embarrassed..."
Everyone who was still listening attentively suddenly had black lines on their faces.
"I want to rush up and kill this old man."
"I wanted to do this last year, but I couldn't beat it!"
"Damn it, there will come a time when he is too old to move, and then I will tear apart all his old bones."
"Count me in."
"And me."
"..."
Seeing the reaction of everyone in the audience, the cultivator quietly opened his eyes just a slit.
"It seems that everyone is very interested in this low-grade martial arts? Are you all brave?"
"Hey, I mean Xiu Lao, can you stop delaying?"
A young disciple couldn't help but said: "Today is the first day of this month, and we will have to collect cultivation resources later!"
"Yes!
Elder Xiu, hurry up and continue talking!
I feel that I am very strong, so I can try this "Nine Continuous Collapse". "
"..."
Xiao Nuo in the field was also more and more surprised. Everyone was obviously very angry with Elder Xiu, but still only a few people left the field.
Of course, he was not the only one who was as confused as Xiao Nuo.
Not far away, there was a newcomer who had just started this year and asked the people around him.
"Why don't you leave? It's just a low-grade martial arts. Even if it is given to the younger generations of our family, not many people are willing to practice it."
The person next to me replied: "You just came here and you don't know anything.
The techniques taught by Elder Xiu are very practical and easy to understand, but the only shortcoming of this old man is that he talks too much and can often make people half-dead. "
"Highly practical?"
The newcomer was even more puzzled.
"That's right, in fact, the techniques taught by Elder Xiu have all been adjusted and improved by him. The so-called low-grade martial arts and mid-grade martial arts are just what he said casually. As for how strong the martial arts he taught actually is, you can only know it if you practice it."
"That's it!"
"..."
Scolding for scolding, resentment for resentment, even if he couldn't hide the look in his eyes, there was no doubt about Elder Xiu's recognition of the teaching of Kung Fu.
The elder Xiu sat on the stone chair and stretched himself.
"I've finished talking... Next is the 'practical practice' session."
As soon as these words came out, the No. 24 power transmission platform suddenly became noisy.
"That's it? Is there anything wrong?"
"Elder Xiu, don't cause trouble!"
"..."
Faced with everyone's strong persuasion, Elder Xiu ignored it.
"I have made it very clear that the "Nine Continuous Collapse Strikes" relies on the nine powerful force-generating points of the human body to continuously exert force. The stronger the body, the stronger the internal energy contained, and the better the effect of the combo... How else to explain such a simple truth?"
"Just 'practice'!"
title_en: Chapter 21: How can a mere outer sect disciple have the ability to practice this martial art? Chapter 22: Explodes with one punch on the training platform
